eiffel_tower.name: Eiffel Tower
eiffel_tower.optimal_booking_window: 3–7 days before (summit); same-day for 2nd floor off-peak
eiffel_tower.best_time: Sunrise (8:30–10 AM) or golden hour (8–10 PM)
eiffel_tower.guidance: Book summit access for sunset slots — they sell out first.

louvre.name: Louvre Museum
louvre.avoid_times: Wednesdays after 3 PM if short on time; closed Tuesdays
louvre.best_time: Opening (9 AM) or Friday evening extended hours
louvre.crowd_pattern: Busiest near Mona Lisa 10 AM–3 PM
louvre.guidance: Enter via Passage Richelieu or Carrousel du Louvre to skip main pyramid queue.

louvre_museum.name: Louvre Museum
louvre_museum.guidance: Download museum map and pick 3 wings max for one visit.

notre_dame.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
notre_dame.avoid_times: Sunday mass times if touring exterior only
notre_dame.guidance: Interior restoration ongoing — check latest visitor access; Île de la Cité walk is free.

versailles.name: Palace of Versailles
versailles.avoid_times: Tuesday crowds when Louvre is closed
versailles.best_time: 9 AM opening — gardens first, palace mid-morning
versailles.guidance: Passport required for passport-holder free days — verify eligibility.

teamlab.name: teamLab Planets
teamlab.avoid_times: Weekends after 2 PM, Japanese public holidays
teamlab.guidance: Wear shoes you can remove quickly — some rooms are water-based.

teamLab_planets.name: teamLab Planets
teamLab_planets.guidance: Arrive 15 minutes before slot — late entry may be denied.

ghibli.name: Ghibli Museum
ghibli.guidance: Purchase via Lawson Ticket website — passports required at entry.

ghibli_museum.name: Ghibli Museum
ghibli_museum.guidance: No photos inside — plan Mitaka stroll afterward.

shibuya.name: Shibuya Crossing
shibuya.avoid_times: Late night if safety is a concern
shibuya.best_time: Weekday 7–9 PM for peak crossing energy
shibuya.guidance: View from Shibuya Sky or Starbucks Tsutaya for iconic photos.

shibuya_crossing.name: Shibuya Crossing
shibuya_crossing.guidance: Free public experience — combine with Hachiko statue visit.

skytree.name: Tokyo Skytree
skytree.best_time: Sunset slot for city lights transition
skytree.guidance: Tembo Galleria add-on worth it for glass-floor views.

tokyo_skytree.name: Tokyo Skytree
tokyo_skytree.guidance: Solamachi mall at base — good for dinner after visit.

universal_studios.name: Universal Studios Japan
universal_studios.optimal_booking_window: 7–14 days before; Express Pass 2–4 weeks for Mario
universal_studios.avoid_times: Weekends, school holidays, rainy days (still crowded)
universal_studios.best_time: Park opening — head to Super Nintendo World first
universal_studios.guidance: Express Pass almost essential for Nintendo World timed entry.

disneyland.name: Tokyo Disneyland
disneyland.guidance: Download official app for standby passes and mobile ordering.

sensoji.name: Senso-ji Temple (Asakusa)
sensoji.best_time: Early morning (6–8 AM) for photos without crowds
sensoji.guidance: Free entry — combine with Sumida River walk.

oia.name: Oia Sunset Viewing
oia.guidance: No advance tickets — reserve dinner terrace or arrive very early for castle ruins spot.

oia_sunset.name: Oia Sunset Viewing
oia_sunset.guidance: Fira sunset is less crowded alternative with caldera views.

akrotiri.name: Akrotiri Archaeological Site
akrotiri.optimal_booking_window: Optional online ticket to skip queue
akrotiri.guidance: Covered walkways — one of the best-preserved Bronze Age sites.

monkey_forest.name: Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest
monkey_forest.optimal_booking_window: Tickets at gate — no pre-book needed
monkey_forest.guidance: Secure sunglasses and phones — monkeys will grab loose items.

ubud_sacred_monkey_forest.name: Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest
ubud_sacred_monkey_forest.guidance: Do not feed or stare at monkeys — follow staff instructions.

tanah_lot.name: Tanah Lot Temple
tanah_lot.guidance: Iconic ocean temple — cannot enter inner temple unless praying.

mount_batur.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
mount_batur.guidance: Book licensed guide — includes breakfast at summit tradition.

grand_palace.name: Grand Palace Bangkok
grand_palace.avoid_times: Midday heat; closed during royal ceremonies
grand_palace.guidance: Strict dress code — rent cover-ups nearby if needed.

wat_pho.name: Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha)
wat_pho.guidance: Combine with Grand Palace — 10-min walk between sites.
